model.description: A compact multilingual Whisper speech-recognition model that runs locally in the browser and supports transcription, translation to English, and optional word- or segment-level timestamps.
intendedUses: Private, client-side transcription of short and medium-length speech recordings.
Generating word- or segment-timestamped transcripts for captions and search.
Translating supported spoken languages into English text.
Prototyping browser speech-recognition features without a hosted inference API.
limitations: Tiny prioritizes download size and speed over the accuracy of larger Whisper variants.
Word timestamps are approximate DTW alignments and may drift around silence, noise, or overlapping speech.
Accuracy varies by language, accent, recording quality, background noise, and domain vocabulary.
Long recordings are chunked and may contain boundary repetition or omissions.
Generated transcripts must not be treated as authoritative for safety-critical decisions.

input.description: Provide exactly one 16 kHz mono Float32Array or a browser blob URL containing WAV/MP3 audio.

alternatives.name: decoded audio
alternatives.description: Fastest path; audio is already decoded and resampled by the application.

fields.name: audio
fields.description: Mono PCM samples at 16 kHz in the range -1 to 1.

alternatives.name: audio blob
alternatives.description: Worker fetches and decodes a WAV or MP3 browser object URL.

fields.name: audio_blob_url
fields.description: A blob: URL accessible from this worker.

model.name: language
model.description: Spoken-language name or code; omit for automatic detection.

model.name: task
model.description: Preserve the source language or translate speech to English.

model.name: return_timestamps
model.description: Word timestamps, segment timestamps, or text only.

model.name: condition_on_prev_tokens
model.description: Use prior decoded tokens as context across chunks.

model.name: no_speech_threshold
model.description: Probability threshold used to classify a segment as silence.

model.name: num_beams
model.description: Beam-search width; larger values trade speed for search quality.

generation.name: stride_length_s
generation.description: Overlap on each side; cannot exceed half the chunk duration.

output.description: The worker returns model-specific transcription data. WebAI wraps it as { result, runtime: { durationMs } }.

fields.name: chunks
fields.type: Array<{ text: string, timestamp: [number, number | null] }>
fields.description: Timestamped words or segments when requested.

benchmark.note: Measured values are machine/browser-specific; regenerate the report on target hardware.
